description:
ROOT CAUSE (verified twice: builder STOP report + cold review reproduction,
2026-08-31, both at a0a92a8cb): the brand-blind activation key is not a
join homomorphism because Types::intern (types/mod.rs:226) canonicalizes
ONLY the tuples axis. The evidence union keeps both branded funcs conjuncts
(dnf_union's dedupe fires at union time, when the lits still differ,
dnf.rs:8-37); ActivationKey::from_inputs addresses both to the same
positional vars; erase_closure_identity (mod.rs:2228, without_closure_lits
descr.rs:290) strips the lits IN PLACE leaving EXACT structural duplicate
clauses (probed: up to 7 identical copies, exact_dups=conjs-1 on 100% of
multi-conjunct erased slots); funcs=[C,C] interns as a different Ty than
funcs=[C], so the coalesce re-mint mints a wider key and the published edge
loses the walked keys (70/0/54 loss events, 10/0/10 lost keys on
take_drop/range_map/predicate).

## THE FIX (cold-reviewed ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES): Stage-1 intern dedupe
Exact-duplicate clause removal (A OR A = A) in Types::intern on
funcs/lists/resources/maps (tuples already has the stronger pass);
first-occurrence-kept, len()<2 bail, retain-style (no Vec::remove, no
sort); extend debug_assert_tuple_axis_hygienic (mod.rs:170-186) with a
no-exact-duplicates sweep over the other four axes. Chokepoint verified:
TypeInterner::intern has exactly one caller. Consumer sweep found NO
semantic dependence on clause multiplicity/order; watch items:
refine_widen (mod.rs:2237-2322) starts taking the pairwise-merge branch for
formerly duplicate-laden descrs (denotationally sound, type-changing);
pure_* gates flip None->Some in convergence-class code (mod.rs:600-716,
intended direction); canon_test.rs:150-159 collapsed-count pin shifts.

RED-FIRST (both): (a) the production-path invariant test
(kdt80-evidence/kdt80.red-test.patch): every standing ReturnType(k) read
appears on a claimed CallSiteTargets edge -- RED at base
(10,10)/(0,0)/(10,10), lands as the permanent gate (this also delivers
fz-kdt.89's orphans=0 pin); (b) a types-level unit test: union two
same-surface different-brand closure lits, erase_closure_identity, assert
ONE funcs clause and from_inputs(union) == from_inputs(each).

MEASURED (cold review, all-axes dedupe prototype, reverted): loss 0/0/0;
invariant test GREEN; analyzed activations 283->247 / 255->231 / 75->75;
Activation claims 198->174 (predicate); inventory pins HOLD (59/221/214);
lambda-sharing pin HOLDS; behavior byte-identical; wall-clock neutral;
double-compile deterministic. Funcs-only variant moves canon identically,
so the movement is intrinsic.

## STOP: THE FIX MOVES CANON ON take_drop -- AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED
Canon diff 69 lines, executable x176 (List.reduce_while_cont/3), two
components:
1. CLAUSE-ORDER PERMUTATION (clause_ids [0,1]->[1,0]): pre-existing
   schedule coupling -- artifact clause order = ROW-ARRIVAL order
   (reachable_clauses built first-occurrence from alternatives.rows(),
   jobs/semantic.rs:145-163, materialized verbatim at
   jobs/artifact.rs:1650-1655). ANY key-population change trips it. Filed
   as its own ticket (fz-kdt.91).
2. MONOTONE NARROWING: the Empty clause's dead _reducer param narrows from
   a 7-closure union to 3 -- this IS the bug's corrected output (the
   non-homomorphic re-mint was funneling blended rows into the
   activation). Irreducible; dispatch plan, inventory, behavior unchanged.
Decision for the owner: (i) authorize the movement as-is (strongest case
of any measured repair: permutation + monotone precision gain, all pins
held), or (ii) land fz-kdt.91 (derive clause order from body/source order
at final packaging -- legal sort, packaging-only) FIRST, then re-measure so
the residual movement is exactly the narrowing. Same-commit re-pins after
authorization: ANALYSIS_CLAIM_RATCHET rows (downward), canon_test
collapsed count, refreshed canon dumps.

## STAGE 2 (delete the re-mint) REFUTED -- do not rebuild here
A1-on-top-of-Stage-1 still miscompiles (Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5],3) ->
[1,2,3,4,5]; canon diverges 2552 lines): key equality != emission
idempotence -- rebuild_coalesced_call_emission (jobs/semantic.rs:1131-1216)
also recomputes contract return refinement, the blended surface, and the
blended-row ActivationContribution. The rebuild's deletion belongs to
fz-kdt.81 (the correlated row carrier supersedes the column-wise blend;
merge_summary_input_vec dies there in the same motion). Here: keep the
re-mint, add debug_assert(walked key == rebuilt key) once Stage 1 lands.
Honest note: Stage 1 itself supersedes nothing deletable -- dnf_union's
union-time dedupe still protects un-interned mid-computation Descrs.

## SEQUENCING
Land fz-kdt.86 (in flight, disjoint files, both move
ANALYSIS_CLAIM_RATCHET) first; re-measure every number here on the merged
base. Then this, per the owner's (i)/(ii) decision.

PARKED EVIDENCE: /Users/j5n/Workspace/kdt80-evidence/ (red-test patch,
A1/A2/B patches, base+A2 canon dumps; A2 = edge names walked-union-rebuilt,
+10 executables, inverts the lambda-sharing pin -- superseded by Stage 1
which fixes the key instead of widening the edge). Cold-review measurement
artifacts: scratchpad/cold/{base,stage1,funcsonly,s1a1}. Probe recipes: in
this ticket's history sections above and kdt80-evidence.
title: Intern-time A-or-A dedupe makes the activation key join-stable (cold-reviewed; STOP: canon moves on take_drop, owner authorization required)
